title: Counseling Techniques and Skills
welcome: This is the skills laboratory of the programme. Here, empathy is trained into technique, and technique is kept humane by empathy.
vignette: In a practice session, a student counselor asks a perfect question at the wrong moment, and watches the role-play client close like a door. The supervisor pauses the video. Timing, she says, is a skill. We can build it.
description: The flagship skills course: microskills training, the structure of the counseling session, empathy and advanced attending, questioning and confrontation, building alliances with children, adolescents, and caregivers, and deliberate practice with structured feedback until skill becomes habit.
questions: What exactly do I say, and when?
How do I stay present while I stay technical?
How is skill built and measured?
importance: Skills are what a client actually experiences of your training
Deliberate practice with feedback is the proven route to competence
Alliance, built by skill, is the strongest predictor of outcome
misconceptions: that good people are naturally good counselors, when skill is trained not innate
that technique is cold, when disciplined technique is how care reaches the client
figures: whose microskills hierarchy made counseling teachable
who operationalized empathy and facilitating conditions
whose conditions remain the benchmark of the helping relationship
outcomes: You will attend, question, reflect, and summarize with smooth competence.
Structure sessions from opening to closing
You will open, focus, deepen, and close a session with intention.
Build alliances with young clients and caregivers
You will earn trust from a child and a parent in the same room.
Use self-awareness as a clinical instrument
You will monitor your own reactions and use them as data.
You will treat resistance as information and silence as material.
You will rehearse targeted skills with feedback until they hold under pressure.
modules: The hierarchy is the alphabet of every later skill.
Listening is the most active skill in the room.
Structure frees the client to feel safe enough to be honest.
Challenge must be carried in warmth or it wounds.
Building Alliance with Children and Adolescents
With minors you hold two alliances at once; this module teaches the balance.
Feedback is the fertilizer of skill; we schedule it deliberately.
Integration proves the parts have become a whole.
practicum: Recorded microskills labs with structured feedback
assessment: Recorded skills demonstrations rated with standardized rubrics
A full recorded session with self-critique
tips: Record yourself weekly and watch with a rubric
Practice one microskill at a time to mastery
Treat feedback as a gift and seek it actively
integration: Every clinical course after this one assumes these skills; this is where they are built.
faith: Skill is stewardship. We train the hands and the voice because they carry our care to another soul.
closing: May your skills grow until they disappear into presence, and may your presence always carry skill.
